decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s core support promise, premium customer support fits the announced strategy, can be justified as needing time to scale, and is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly despite any mixed results.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm’s technical platform and R&D capabilities, so prior development investment and strategic fit make management inclined to continue rather than retreat.

Although the firm has invested visibly in this product line, its greater distance from the core hosting and support business makes it easier to abandon once management reallocates resources toward more central offerings.

Scalable hosting for agencies is highly central to the firm’s core market, was promoted prominently on the home page, and therefore benefits most from escalation of commitment and continued managerial support.
